problems.quote: Ganga basin closures came in later cases , establishing the principle of absolute liability for hazardous activities
problems.problem: The later Ganga basin cases applied the principle of absolute liability; they did not establish it. The principle was established in M.C. Mehta v. Union of India (1987).
problems.correction: Ganga basin closures came in later cases, applying the principle of absolute liability for hazardous activities
problems.verifierReason: Absolute liability was established in M.C. Mehta v. Union of India (1987) Oleum case; Ganga cases applied it.

problems.quote: Constitution mandates their impartiality (Article 93 for Speaker, Article 89 for Chairman)
problems.problem: Articles 93 and 89 deal only with the election/appointment of the Speaker/Deputy Speaker and Chairman/Deputy Chairman; they do not contain any mandate of impartiality. Impartiality is a constitutional convention, not a textual requirement in those articles.
problems.correction: Constitution expects their impartiality by convention; Articles 93 and 89 govern their election
problems.verifierReason: Articles 89 and 93 only provide for election of Chairman/Dy Chairman and Speaker/Dy Speaker; impartiality is a convention, not textual mandate in those articles.

problems.problem: Inter-state water disputes are not within the Supreme Court's original jurisdiction; they are excluded by Article 262 and adjudicated by tribunals.
problems.verifierReason: Inter-state water disputes are excluded from SC original jurisdiction by Art 262; boundary disputes fall under Art 131.

problems.quote: In 2022, the LRF projected “above normal” rainfall (106 % LPA).
problems.problem: The IMD's April 2022 Long-Range Forecast projected normal rainfall at 99% LPA, not above normal at 106% LPA.
problems.correction: In 2022, the LRF projected “normal” rainfall (99 % LPA).
problems.verifierReason: IMD's April 2022 LRF forecast was 99% LPA (normal), not 106% (above normal).

problems.quote: the subsidised issue price (typically 50 % of MSP for PDS, 75 % for open‑market sales)
problems.problem: PDS issue price is fixed at ₹2/kg wheat and ₹3/kg rice under NFSA, far below 50% of MSP; open-market sale price under OMSS is not a fixed 75% of MSP.
problems.correction: the subsidised issue price (₹2/kg wheat and ₹3/kg rice for PDS under NFSA; OMSS prices for open-market sales)
problems.verifierReason: NFSA fixes PDS prices at ₹2/kg wheat, ₹3/kg rice — far below 50% MSP; OMSS prices are not fixed at 75% MSP.

problems.quote: The 2023‑24 Union Budget announced a pilot to link PM‑KISAN instalments with a “procurement‑linked bonus” — an additional ₹500 per quintal for farmers who sell a minimum of 50 % of their marketed surp
problems.problem: The 2023-24 Union Budget did not announce such a pilot; no such scheme exists.
problems.correction: No such pilot was announced in the 2023-24 Union Budget.
problems.verifierReason: 2023-24 Union Budget (Feb 2023) contains no such PM-KISAN procurement-linked bonus pilot.

problems.problem: The figure 79% is incorrect; IPCC AR6 WGIII states developed countries (Annex I) account for approximately 57% of cumulative CO2 emissions since 1850.
problems.verifierReason: IPCC AR6 WGIII SPM and Ch.2 state Annex I countries contributed ~57% of cumulative CO2 (1850-2019), not 79%.
